# AWS SAM Reference & Patterns (Simplified)

This knowledge base provides essential AWS SAM templates, resource definitions, and policy patterns for the Serverless Migration project. This is a simplified version focusing on the most commonly used patterns.

## 1. Standard SAM Template Structure

### Header & Globals
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: Serverless application infrastructure

Globals:
  Function:
    # Basic Configuration (Required)
    Runtime: python3.12  # Adjust based on actual code
    Handler: index.handler
    Timeout: 30  # seconds
    MemorySize: 512  # MB
    # Graviton: 20% lower GB-second price; as fast or faster in this project's
    # real-AWS A/B (m2s-mcp-server PERF_OPTIMIZATION_DESIGN.md A.4). Keep
    # x86_64 only when a dependency ships x86-only compiled modules.
    Architectures:
      - arm64
    
    # Environment Variables (Common)
    Environment:
      Variables:
        ENVIRONMENT: !Ref Environment
        LOG_LEVEL: INFO
    
    # Monitoring & Tracing (Recommended)
    Tracing: Active  # Enable X-Ray tracing
    
    # Shared Layers (Optional)
    Layers:
      - !Ref CommonLayer
    
    # Tags (Recommended)
    Tags:
      Project: MyProject
      Environment: !Ref Environment
```

### Parameters
```yaml
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues: [dev, staging, prod]
```

## 2. Resource Patterns

### Lambda Function Pattern
```yaml
{LambdaName}Function:
  Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
  Properties:
    # ========== Required Configuration ==========
    CodeUri: backend/lambdas/{lambda_name}/
    Handler: handler.lambda_handler
    Runtime: python3.12  # python3.12, nodejs22.x, etc.
    
    # ========== Common Configuration ==========
    MemorySize: 512  # 128-10240 MB (affects CPU and cost)
    Timeout: 30  # seconds (max 900)
    
    Description: "Function description"  # Optional but recommended
    
    # Environment Variables
    Environment:
      Variables:
        TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
        BUCKET_NAME: !Ref BucketName
    
    # Shared Code Layers
    Layers:
      - !Ref CommonLayer
    
    # Permission Policies (choose one approach)
    Policies:
      # Approach 1: SAM Policy Templates (Recommended)
      - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
          TableName: !Ref TableName
      
      # Approach 2: Inline Policy (Fine-grained control)
      - Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${BucketName}/*
          
          # AI/ML Services
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - comprehend:DetectSentiment
              - rekognitio
```

# ===========================================================================
  # Lambda Functions (S3b) -- 14 API functions, one endpoint per function
  # (blueprint.lambda_functions; storage/DECISIONS.md D-1).
  #
  # CodeUri / Handler are read off the real files on disk, not off the
  # blueprint's placeholder handler value: every directory under
  # output/lambdas/airline-booking/ holds a handler.py with a module-level
  # `def lambda_handler(event, context)`, so Handler is handler.lambda_handler
  # (gate C3). Runtime / Timeout / MemorySize / Architectures / Tracing come
  # from Globals.Function in part1 and are not repeated here.
  #
  # Events: every function is triggered by the shared HTTP API "Api"
  # (blueprint.api_gateway.api_type = "http", D-2), so Type: HttpApi with
  # ApiId: !Ref Api and PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0' -- SAM's own default (2.0)
  # would move body/queryStringParameters/requestContext.authorizer.claims and
  # break the monolith's event semantics (gate AT2). Paths/methods are the
  # blueprint entry_points verbatim (gate C7), including the {param} spelling the
  # handlers read from event.pathParameters.
  #
  # Auth (gate C7b, D-5): the 7 auth="required" functions inherit the Api's
  # DefaultAuthorizer (CognitoAuthorizer) and therefore carry NO Auth block.
  # The 7 auth="none" functions override it with Auth: {Authorizer: NONE} on the
  # event, otherwise the gateway would 401 a public endpoint.
  #
  # Policies: one SAM policy template per table the function's handler actually
  # touches (per-handler evidence in the comment above each Policies block);
  # DynamoDBReadPolicy where the handler only reads (get_item/query/scan),
  # DynamoDBCrudPolicy where it writes (put_item/update_item). Environment
  # variables are exactly blueprint.lambda_functions[].environment_variables,
  # with ${FlightTable} & Co. resolved to !Ref of part1's table logical names.
  #
  # No SQS/EventBridge events, no ReportBatchItemFailures, no idempotency table:
  # blueprint has_async_flows=false with sqs_queues / eventbridge_rules /
  # lambda_invoke_permissions all [] (D-6, D-13) -- all cross-service work is
  # inlined in the request path.
  # ===========================================================================

  # ----- Domain: Flights (catalog: search / detail / seat hold / seat release) -----
  FlightsSearchFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      CodeUri: lambdas/airline-booking/flights-search/
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Layers:
        - !Ref SharedUtilsLayer
      Environment:
        Variables:
          FLIGHT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref FlightTable
      # handler.py: flight_table.scan(FilterExpression=...) -- reads only (D-8)
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBReadPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref FlightTable
      Events:
        FlightsSearch:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            ApiId: !Ref Api
            Path: /flights/search
            Method: GET
            PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'
            Auth:
              Authorizer: NONE          # blueprint auth = "none"

  FlightsGetFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      CodeUri: lambdas/airline-booking/flights-get/
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Layers:
        - !Ref SharedUtilsLayer
      Environment:
        Variables:
          FLIGHT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref FlightTable
      # handler.py: flight_table.get_item(Key={"id": flight_id}) -- reads only
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBReadPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref FlightTable
      Events:
        FlightGet:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            ApiId: !Ref Api
            Path: /flights/{flight_id}
            Method: GET
            PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'
            Auth:
              Authorizer: NONE          # blueprint auth = "none"

  FlightsReserveFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      CodeUri: lambdas/airline-booking/flights-reserve/
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Layers:
        - !Ref SharedUtilsLayer
      Environment:
        Variables:
          FLIGHT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref FlightTable
      # handler.py: flight_table.update_item(... seatCapacity condition) -- atomic write
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref FlightTable
      Events:
        FlightReserve:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            ApiId: !Ref Api
            Path: /flights/{flight_id}/reserve
            Method: POST
            PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'
            Auth:
              Authorizer: NONE          # blueprint auth = "none"

  FlightsReleaseFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      CodeUri: lambdas/airline-booking/flights-release/
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Layers:
        - !Ref SharedUtilsLayer
      Environment:
        Variables:
          FLIGHT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref FlightTable
      # handler.py: flight_table.get_item + flight_table.update_item -- writes
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref FlightTable
      Events:
        FlightRelease:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            ApiId: !Ref Api
            Path: /flights/{flight_id}/release
            Method: POST
            PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'
            Auth:
              Authorizer: NONE          # blueprint auth = "none"

  # ----- Domain: Bookings (orchestrated in one request path, D-6) -----
  BookingsCreateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      CodeUri: lambdas/airline-booking/bookings-create/
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Layers:
        - !Ref SharedUtilsLayer
      Environment:
        Variables:
          FLIGHT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref FlightTable
          BOOKING_TABLE_NAME: !Ref BookingTable
          PAYMENT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref PaymentTable
          LOYALTY_TABLE_NAME: !Ref LoyaltyTable
      # handler.py: flight_table.get_item + update_item (hold/rollback),
      # booking_table.put_item + update_item, payment_table.put_item + update_item,
      # loyalty_table.put_item -- the whole Saga runs inline, no other Lambda is
      # invoked and no message is sent (D-6, SI-17: no dedupe here).
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref FlightTable
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref BookingTable
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref PaymentTable
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref LoyaltyTable
      Events:
        BookingCreate:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            ApiId: !Ref Api
            Path: /bookings
            Method: POST
            PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'
            # auth = "required": inherits DefaultAuthorizer (CognitoAuthorizer);
            # the identity is read from event.requestContext.authorizer.claims.sub (SI-9).

  BookingsGetFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      CodeUri: lambdas/airline-booking/bookings-get/
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Layers:
        - !Ref SharedUtilsLayer
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BOOKING_TABLE_NAME: !Ref BookingTable
          USER_GROUPS_TABLE_NAME: !Ref UserGroupsTable
      # handler.py: booking_table.get_item + user_groups_table.get_item (owner/admin
      # decision stays in the function, D-5); one read of the booking item (SI-1).
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBReadPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref BookingTable
        - DynamoDBReadPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref UserGroupsTable
      Events:
        BookingGet:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            ApiId: !Ref Api
            Path: /bookings/{booking_id}
            Method: GET
            PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'
            # auth = "required": inherits DefaultAuthorizer

  BookingsConfirmFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      CodeUri: lambdas/airline-booking/bookings-confirm/
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Layers:
        - !Ref SharedUtilsLayer
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BOOKING_TABLE_NAME: !Ref BookingTable
          USER_GROUPS_TABLE_NAME: !Ref UserGroupsTable
      # handler.py: booking_table.get_item + update_item (conditional write whose

      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref BookingTable
        - DynamoDBReadPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref UserGroupsTable
      Events:
        BookingConfirm:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            ApiId: !Ref Api
            Path: /bookings/{booking_id}/confirm
            Method: POST
            PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'
            # auth = "required": inherits DefaultAuthorizer

  BookingsCancelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      CodeUri: lambdas/airline-booking/bookings-cancel/
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Layers:
        - !Ref SharedUtilsLayer
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BOOKING_TABLE_NAME: !Ref BookingTable
          FLIGHT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref FlightTable
          PAYMENT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref PaymentTable
          USER_GROUPS_TABLE_NAME: !Ref UserGroupsTable

      # flight_table.get_item + update_item (seat release), payment_table.update_item
      # (refund; absent row / failed write is swallowed, SI-6), user_groups_table.get_item.
      Policies:
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref BookingTable
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref FlightTable
        - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref PaymentTable
        - DynamoDBReadPolicy:
            TableName: !Ref UserGroupsTable
      Events:
        BookingCancel:
          Type: HttpApi
          Properties:
            ApiId: !Ref Api
            Path: /bookings/{booking_id}/cancel
            Method: POST
            PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'
            # auth = "required": inherits DefaultAuthorizer

  # ----- Domain: Customers -----
  CustomersBookingsListFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      CodeUri: lambdas/airline-booking/customers-bookings-list/
      Handler: handler.lambda_handler
      Layers:

      Environment:
        Variables:

          USER_GROUPS_TABLE_NAME: !Ref UserGroupsTable
